description.value: The Ramada by Wyndham Campbell River is a mid-scale chain hotel located in Campbell River, a hub city on northern Vancouver Island and a common stop on touring routes between Nanaimo and the north island. As part of the Wyndham Rewards network, it offers a familiar branded stay experience in a community that serves as a jumping-off point for Discovery Passage and beyond.

address.value: 462 S Island Hwy, Campbell River, BC V9W 1A5, Canada
